Spotlight: Has won a bumper here, a maiden hurdle here and a novice hurdle at Carlisle, all at around 2m1f; yet to prove he stays this sort of trip and has jumped left at times in most recent chase starts; off since heavy handicap defeat at Fairyhouse in April.

RaceName: Seamus Byrne Electrical Chase
Spotlight: 0-5 in points and pulled up in four of them; pulled up on hurdles debut at Cork in July 2025 and beaten 50l when completing in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon 10 days ago; visor goes on for chase debut; impossible to fancy.

RaceName: Betfred "Double Delight" Handicap
Spotlight: Won two 7f AW novice races during the winter and, following a break, was second of four behind Trio over C&D (good to firm) on turf debut a fortnight ago; 4lb better off with that filly today and will be hard to beat if the run brought her on.

RaceName: Betfred "Double Delight" Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to his 7f AW 2yo win but has performed well in four handicaps since returned to turf in May, most recently when seventh of 19 at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; in calmer waters here and could be a threat if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.

RaceName: Betfred "Double Delight" Handicap
OwnerName: M H Dixon & J L Rowsell
Spotlight: Improving filly who won twice over C&D on good to firm ground last month; raised another 5lb since beating Chantelle in four-runner race on latter occasion but still has obvious claims.

RaceName: Betfred "Double Delight" Handicap
Spotlight: Useful 2yo (and course winner) when trained by Eve Johnson Houghton but soundly beaten in three handicaps (7f-1m) for new stable this year; may yet turn things around for Neil Mulholland but it's probably wise to wait for some encouraging signals from the betting.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Johnny Hall And Mrs David Nutting
Spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; eleventh foal; closely related to two winners including Dubka (1m4f; RPR 108), half-brother to five winners including Soffika (6f; 99), Zikany (11.4f/2m; 84) and Copperplate (1m4f turf/2m AW; 66); dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (106); has quite a bit of stamina in pedigree and he could be a longer-term prospect.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 30,000gns brother to German 6f 2yo winner Nitaro and half-brother to winners Brave Knight (11.4f/2m Flat, RPR 88; 2m-2m3f hurdle) and Navid (1m6f; 79); withdrawn after getting unruly in the stalls at Ascot (33-1) last month and he's been gelded since.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 58,000euros yearling; third foal; half-brother to winners Saga Gaga (9.4f/11.4f; RPR 98) and Far Ahead (7f; 77); dam 1m2f winner (70), half-sister to useful 8.6f/9.7f winner Sagely (dam of triple 6f Group 1 winner Perfect Power); yard 11% with 2yos this season and market should guide on debut.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; closely related to 1m 2yo (RPR 66) and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Tara Iti, half-brother to winners Hariboux (7f-1m1f including 2yo/US stakes; 97) and Chilli Queen (1m4f; 96); dam 1m2f turf/1m4f AW winner (88); already been gelded and yard is 1-24 with 2yos in recent years.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 20,000gns foal, 45,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to 6f winner Two Summers (RPR 62); dam 7f AW winner (including 2yo; 88), out of 1m winning half-sister to 1m Listed winner Token Of Love; yard 15% with 2yos this season and interesting to see how he figures in market.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 25-1 and was never involved when a well-held sixth of nine at Leicester (7f, good) in June; been gelded since and he needs major improvement after a short break.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well held when prominent in the market in both starts, most recently when a 5l third at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month; that was much better than his debut form but he needs to build on that; stablemate of Royal Instinct.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Honorable Earle I Mack International I
Spotlight: 55,000gns foal, 32,000gns yearling; third foal; brother to 1m4f AW winner Ada Rose (RPR 57); dam runner-up 7f AW (73), sister to winners Fourth Way (6f 2yo) and Perfect Step (7f), half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner System, out of 6f 2yo/1m1f winner; one of two newcomers for Ed Dunlop and market should tell the tale.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to winners Loraxed (French 7f) and Montauk (Swedish 1m/8.6f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m4f Listed/2m1f Irish Cesarewitch winner The Euphrates, out of half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Golan; first 2yo runner for yard this season and he's probably best watched.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 23,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Chica De Ciudad (French Listed-placed 7f-9.5f; RPR 103) and Ourbren (Listed-placed 1m; 90); dam unraced half-sister to US 1m2f Grade 3 winner Homerique, out of US 6f winner; plenty to like on paper and she needs a close look on debut.

RaceName: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bangkok filly out of a bumper, 2m hurdle and 1m4f AW (RPR 82) winner from just four starts; weak 10-1 shot for a C&D maiden last month but she made some late headway and was only beaten around 3l in fifth of ten; should know more this time and she's a key player for in-form yard.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Came up short in two Group races after her maiden win at Bath (5.7f, firm) in May; fine second in a nursery at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago and that form brings her right into the reckoning; drops to 5f for the first time but she shouldn't be underestimated.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Two runs over 6f at Newmarket, finishing last of three on debut (travelled best and looked set to win 1f out) before a narrow win five weeks ago; that form looks solid and she should have more to offer; drop to 5f shouldn't be an issue.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Sprang a 33-1 surprise in a soft-ground maiden at Chepstow (5f) on her debut in June; confirmed there was no fluke about that success when beaten a nose over C&D in the Super Sprint four weeks ago but that form isn't working out and this will demand more.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Made a winning debut at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm; form worked out) and confirmed herself a useful filly when fourth, conceding a penalty, in a useful novice at Ascot (6f, good to firm; first and third run in earlier races on the card) three weeks ago;  needs more for the drop in trip but it is not out of the question.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Clear promise in her two completed starts but she will need a good jolt of improvement to feature at this level.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: A win and a third in 5f nurseries at Yarmouth this summer; can win more races but she is in much deeper this time.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: 350,000gns breeze-up purchase; created a positive impression when winning a 5f fillies' novice at Newmarket (good to firm) at the Guineas meeting and the form looks solid; her subsequent absence and the addition of a tongue-tie raise slight concerns but she looked a fine prospect in the spring.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Shaped well over 6f on debut before failing to stay 7f at Goodwood; proved well suited by the drop to 5f at Sandown last week, powering home to win by over 2l; this is much tougher but she still has potential.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Her first three runs were encouraging and she has proved a different proposition since a tongue-tie went on, bolting up at Beverley and then a fine second in a good conditions race at Goodwood (both 5f, good to firm); strong contender.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Disappointed as favourite on her Newmarket debut but made amends at Yarmouth (5f, good) on her second start; struggled at Royal Ascot but this should be easier; now fitted with a tongue-tie.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Won her first two starts before finishing a creditable third in a York Listed race; well beaten at Royal Ascot but a revival isn't out of the question for last year's winning connections.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Finished in front of Acting Lady at Newmarket in June; stretched by 7f next time but she made no mistake back at 6f two weeks ago, keeping on well to win a Newmarket novice; improvement required now dropped to 5f for the first time.

RaceName: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Beaten as odds-on favourite at Windsor on Monday; dropping to 5f could help but others have achieved much more.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Debut Curragh run was low-key but much better at Naas (6f, good) last August, showing early speed and beaten just 4l into fifth of 12; ended the campaign with a promising 5f AW effort, second to an odd-on chance; could go close if fit and ready for return.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Ran twice for Paddy Twomey at two; runner-up in two of her three handicap starts, notably behind the ultra-progressive Meriden at the Curragh in June; last month's Navan run can be upgraded slightly since she became unbalanced after briefly hitting the front; closely matched with Cashel Blue, both could cope with the winner Another Nice'Day on these terms.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Won 7f fillies' maiden at Dundalk last December; fair third behind The Right One at Down Royal on her first 5f attempt; more recent form over 7f at Dundalk and 5f at the Curragh is less encouraging.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Several placings last year; off the mark on seasonal return over this trip on soft ground at Down Royal in first-time cheekpieces; got upset in the stalls in the Navan race dominated by several of these rivals.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark on handicap debut at Down Royal in June, with Lady Landhort and Love Bomb among her victims; went up 6lb for that and was right in the mix when third behind Another Nice'Day and Amerilis at Navan; one of the leading contenders.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form in three 5f outings at two; never involved over 1m at Dundalk last month; has a great deal to prove now.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Best run when staying-on sixth in Naas fillies' maiden over 5f last summer; has shown next to nothing in handicaps; transformation needed to feature here.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Best of three handicaps run over this trip at Dundalk in January, beaten only 2l in fifth despite not getting a clear run; in rear at Bellewstown six weeks ago; looked unwilling on the way to post and missed the break, last of 13; hard to be confident.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Now making her first appearance for her third trainer; hard to make a strong case for her following a moderate run at Bellewtown in April; Naas run on seasonal debut was better.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Built on a promising sixth of 21 at Naas to get off the mark at Navan (5f, good), beating today's rivals Amerilis and Cashel Blue, despite being out of the handicap; out of the money at Naas 11 days ago.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
OwnerName: T J Flanagan & Ronan Macken & Shane McSweeney & S O'Malley
Spotlight: Sole success came in 6f Dundalk handicap in March off 49; placed over 5f at the same venue in April; has changed stable since finishing fifth behind Cashel Blue at Down Royal in May; her new trainer also saddles top weight Kiss Don't Tell.

RaceName: OCS Recruitment Handicap
Spotlight: Won nursery over 5f on yielding at Down Royal last September off 17lb higher; unplaced in 11 starts since then; signs that her decline may have been arrested when fourth of 19 over 6f at this venue three weeks ago; should not be written off.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £100,000 yearling by Blue Point; slowly away and finished last at Doncaster (6f; 18-1).

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Only 2l away in the Coventry and, although a beaten favourite at Goodwood after being gelded, he didn't run at all badly in a valuable maiden; should be hard to beat.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 9,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to 5f/6f winner Lord Roxby (RPR 89); dam unraced half-sister to Listed placed 6f-1m winner Eddie Jock and Group-placed 7f-1m2f winner Mawaakef; probably up against it on debut.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 4,000gns yearling; first foal; dam unplaced 1m-1m4f (RPR 62), sister to North American 1m2f/1m3f Grade 2 winner Santa Monica; gelded newcomer from a yard that's doubly represented.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 165,000gns yearling by Kodiac; first foal; dam twice-raced (RPR 65) half-sister to winners Khaloosy (smart 1m/8.6f) and Moqtarreb (1m Listed); the market should be revealing.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 35,000gns breeze-up buy; second foal; dam unplaced 6f-1m in France, half-sister to Listed winners Naturally High (1m2f), Justwantacontact (1m) and General De Vega (6f); best watched.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £37,000 yearling; second foal; dam 6f/7f 2yo winner (RPR 90), closely related to winners Al Aasifh (6f 2yo Listed), Invincible Gold (6f/7f 2yo) and Yalawin (6f); gelded ahead of debut but needs checking in the betting.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Eighth foal; closely related to German 1m winner Debit Card, half-brother to 6f winner Peter The Wolf (RPR 86); dam 5f turf 2yo/7f AW winner (67); already gelded and stable's newcomers are usually best watched.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 160,000euros breeze-up buy; a market drifter on debut (9-1; 6f AW) and faded to be just over 4l behind the winner; he'll need to find plenty on that form if he's to trouble Final Objective.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 80,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Jasour (5f/6f; Group 2; RPR 114) and Nightcall (French 5f); dam unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Twilight Son and 6f Group 3 winners Music Master and Run To Freedom; plenty to like on paper and entered in the Goffs Million at the Curragh.

RaceName: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: D Caslin P Wilcock M Cantillon & Partner
Spotlight: First foal out of a 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 77) and half-sister to winners Saburo (5f 2yo), Blue Dune (2m) and Eagle Fang (useful 1m6f Flat and 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase); rates an unlikely winner first time out.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Bolted up over C&D here in May (Fr Gilligansvoyage second) but pulled up in follow up bid off 5lb higher at Wexford; needs to bounce back but boasts course form figures of 221 so that's not impossible.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Has run well in defeat on occasion over hurdles, including on latest at Downpatrick in a 2m2f mares' maiden; now makes chase debut with stamina to prove for this trip.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden is 0-5 over fences but shaped like his turn was near when narrowly denied at Kilbeggan (20.5f, good) last time; this longer trip fine and should be in the mix again off 2lb higher.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 3-15 over hurdles (including a win here) but remains a maiden over fences after four runs; ran okay off this mark over C&D last August but lacks a recent run and is best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Running well over hurdles this summer; beaten just 4.25l when second at Kilbeggan on latest; however, jumping has lacked fluency at times so will need to improve in that department on chase bow.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 1-16 over hurdles; ran well over an inadequate trip in a Wexford handicap chase (15.5f, good) on latest; best form is at around 2m4f so this trip might just stretch him.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Ended sequence of three pulled up efforts when off the mark over hurdles in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Ballinrobe on latest (2m6f, good) when a 50-1 shot; 7lb higher for chase debut; can't be discounted.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 2-25 over hurdles but 0-7 over fences and yet to trouble the judge; soundly beaten in this race in 2024; 8lb lower now but others make more appeal.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Point winner is 0-15 under Rules; decent run in Downpatrick handicap hurdle on debut for this stable on latest (2m6f, good); place chance if repeats that in his first handicap chase; cheekpieces return.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Produced one of her better efforts in a handicap chase at Wexford on latest but was still beaten over 12l in fourth; same mark here and more needed if she is to shed the maiden tag.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Veteran; won at Downpatrick in June off 3lb lower and has held form well since; weakened late at Wexford last time (24.5f, good); drops in trip and was runner up to Menas Miracle here in June; chance.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Winning hurdler beaten 21l in that sphere on latest; pulled up and beaten 28l in two previous chase starts, albeit those were over inadequate trips; rated 7lb lower over fences so not dismissed.

RaceName: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Point winner has yet to show much under Rules; beaten 47l when midfield at Killarney latest and runs off the same mark here; not easy to make a case for.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Well-bred 5yo; showed promise as a 2yo for Richard Hannon (three runs; 6f-1m) but makes stable/handicap debut after mammoth 1,059-day absence; market helpful.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-time winner; yet to build upon his pleasing seasonal reappearance in March but ran quite well when fourth at Southwell (7f, AW) three weeks ago and switches back to turf on a good mark; can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner who is probably best known for his exploits at Brighton; won there (7f, good to firm) in June and was placed from favourable draw at Chester (7f, good) last month but finished well down the field when last in action and might find others better treated.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Generally disappointing this season but seemingly aided by cheekpieces on last two outings, more recently when fourth of nine at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month; another 2lb lower here; each-way claims if he responds well to the new blinkers.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 for new stable this season; outran 28-1 odds when placed at Newbury (7f, good to firm) in June and is now 4lb below that mark but his more recent efforts have been underwhelming; others preferred.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who came from off the pace to win at Brighton (1m, good) in June; can be excused his recent defeat there (eased when denied clear run) but he's still on a fairly tough mark and this drop back in trip may not be ideal.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on well to score over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago, opening his account at the 12th attempt; subsequent 3lb rise does not look excessive and he ought to be right in the thick of things again.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Gained her breakthrough when dropped to 6f (from 8.3f) at Newmarket (good to firm) in June and ran at least as well when running-on third at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month; slightly disappointing on latest outing but still considered on this move back up to 7f.

RaceName: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap
Spotlight: Appreciated ease in grade and justified favouritism when scoring over C&D (good to firm) four weeks ago, his ninth start; subsequent 3lb rise ought to be manageable and further progress is possible; shortlisted.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Close second on Doncaster debut (7f, good) last June and she took a major step forward with a dominant display over 7f here (6-5 favourite) two weeks later; been absent since but she's bred to stay this new trip and is strongly respected under a penalty on her return.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 375,000gns yearling; first foal; dam French/German 9.5f-1m2f winner (including Listed; RPR 104), half-sister to German 1m2f Group 3 winner Matchwinner, out of French 1m winning sister to Irish 2,000 Guineas winner Saffron Walden; looks the part on paper and he's an interesting newcomer for William Haggas; has same owner as Date Line.

RaceName: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 250,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to two useful winners including Brunch (7f/1m including Listed; RPR 112); showed signs of inexperience on Wolverhampton debut (7f, AW) last month but she finished well and was only narrowly denied; should know more this time and she's open to progress on this step up in trip.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive on AW since handicapping, winning at Lingfield and placed at Kempton and Newcastle (all 1m) on his last two starts; flopped on turf (1m2f, good) in between but reportedly unsuited by going which the trainer's representative felt was slower than advertised; cheekpieces on now dropping to 7f; could still have more to offer.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
Spotlight: His cosy C&D win last summer came off 2lb lower; two good runs and two lesser efforts this season; should give it a good go.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
OwnerName: Total Asbestos Solutions Ltd & A Frost
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 7f win at Chelmsford and he has run well in competitive handicaps on turf this summer, most recently finishing third of 18 at York (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; no obvious reason why he wouldn't make another bold bid.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
Spotlight: Ran out the comfortable winner of a 7f handicap at Lingfield in May; highly tried since and she has come up short; others perhaps better treated.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
OwnerName: HM The King & HM The Queen
Spotlight: Looked good when winning at Haydock (6f, good) on her 2yo debut but beaten in six subsequent starts; unexposed over 7f and this is weaker than the Class 3 C&D event in which she finished fourth of six (sent off favourite) four weeks ago; not discounted.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
Spotlight: 7f AW win as a 2yo; on the up in handicaps this summer, keeping on well to beat five rivals at Sandown (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; 4lb higher in a stronger race but Oisin Murphy takes over for the first time and he has a good record for the stable.

RaceName: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap
Spotlight: No significant improvement for the switch to a handicap here (1m, good) in May but that was his first run after a break and he showed clear promise as a 2yo; still has time to deliver something more potent.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Improved from Leopardstown debut when third at the Curragh, just in front of disappointing favourite Ibelieveicanfly who has since made amends; faces a tough task against the winners.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Wore tongue-tie when scoring readily on debut at Fairyhouse (6f, good); aimed high only nine days later in the Group 2 Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes at Newmarket (6f, good to firm); the form of her third looks rock-solid; winner was the Queen Mary second Senorita Bonita, runner-up was Libertango, who beat subsequent Group 1 winner Sun Goddess in the Albany Stakes.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Beat subsequent Listed winner Big Negotiator and today's rival Madam Secretary in a Listowel maiden in May; third to subsequent Group 1 winner Sun Goddess at the Curragh before a below-par run in France; cheekpieces added now; champion jockey prefers Alwaysanangel.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Improved from her Leopardstown debut on soft to win a 1m Bellewstown maiden on good ground;  in rear in a nursery at Galway; 75-rated filly faces a huge task in this grade.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Looked in need of further when staying on in a Listowel maiden over an extended 6f, beaten 14l in fifth behind Beibhinn; now has a lot more on her plate than winning a maiden over an extended 7f at Roscommon in June.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
OwnerName: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Apprentice-ridden when 5l third of eight behind Beibhinn in a maiden at Listowel in May; third in a 7f maiden at Newmarket last month; hard to be confident now after a third maiden defeat at Galway.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Third foal; sister to the trainer's Group 3-winning filly Red Letter (Group 1-placed in the Pretty Polly) and yard's maiden winner Res Ipsa; justified a good home reputation when scoring readily on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good), despite showing a degree of inexperience; should not be out of place in this grade.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Held by Maire Rua on maiden form, and already had two races under her belt at that stage; made the running for smart stablemate Alpha in a 7f Group 3 at Leopardstown; raised 13lb to a mark of 98 that should make her competitive here in theory.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Long-priced Curragh maiden winner on her third outing; on the upgrade but this looks too demanding for an 80-rated filly.

RaceName: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Behind horses from top yards at Catterick (7f; 125-1) but he was near enough 10l off the winner and that run was nothing to get excited about.

RaceName: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 62,000euros yearling; 22-1 chance when a fader at Newcastle (6f AW) and had to show more.

RaceName: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt who cost 180,000euros as a yearling; made his debut over 6f at Newmarket last month and looked ready for 7f that day, going down by 2l to a filly with experience; clear claims.

RaceName: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 170,000euros yearling; absent since May when making his debut at York (5f, good; also tongue tied) and no disgrace in being no match for Cut A Dash who went on to finish fourth in the Coventry at Royal Ascot; this colt is presumably held in some regard to have gone off 2-1 that day and he's also in the Group 2 Mill Reef.

RaceName: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; third foal; closely related to 7f winner Nakeeb (RPR 91); dam French 1m/1m1f Listed-placed winner (96); would need to be pretty useful to make a successful debut.

RaceName: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f/1m AW 2yo winner Irrelevant (RPR 65); dam lightly raced maiden (66), closely related to 9.4f Group 3 winner Jack Naylor; the only filly running and unlikely to provide the answer to this first time out.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Gradually getting the hang of things over hurdles; produced his best run yet when almost making all at Wexford last time (RPR 114); a repeat of that may suffice here.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Not much impact in point-to-points and while he did finish second on his Rules' debut in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle, he was 31l behind the winner; needs to improve on that.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has attracted market support a couple of times but extended record to 0-7 when beaten favourite in this headgear off 96 in a handicap at Wexford on latest; hard to fancy back in a maiden after that tame effort.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 100-1 and pulled up on debut in a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle; hard to fancy on that evidence.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has displayed ability in a Kilbeggan bumper and when a 5.75l third of 12 on hurdling debut at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) in July; remote fourth upped in trip at Kilbeggan latest and now drops markedly back in distance; place shout.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has shown potential in bumpers and ran a nice race over C&D when a 5.5l third on hurdles debut in May; found to be blowing hard when flopping at Wexford on latest; capable of better than that.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten favourite in both bumpers and on hurdling debut at Roscommon; best run to date when a 1.5l third of 13 in a maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe (17.5f, good) 24 days ago; should be thereabouts again with a repeat of that.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut at Navan in December and again in a 4yo maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan (2m3f) three weeks ago; needs more dropped back in trip.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: No impact in point-to-points and heavy defeat on sole previous start over hurdles in 2024; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has looked limited in two bumper runs and was tailed off in a 1m4f Curragh maiden on the Flat on latest; can only watch on hurdling debut.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner made a modest start under Rules when beaten 52l at odds of 80-1 at Cork; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 4yo filly holds an experience edge; has placed in a couple of handicap hurdles and is rated 107; far from disgraced in decent mares' handicap hurdle at Galway last time out; big player getting lots of weight back in maiden company.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) and Thirsk (1m, good to firm) in the spring and he got back to his best when going very close over C&D two weeks ago; only 1lb higher and he's a big player if he can repeat that form.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: Improved his record to 6-16 when winning at Kempton (7f, AW) in March but he's been well below form in three subsequent runs; now only 1lb higher than for his last success but he needs to get back on track

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been over 1m2f and latest was at this course last August; now 2lb lower but he's been well held in both runs this season and is untried at this trip; something to prove in another switch of headgear.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: On dangerous mark but he's generally struggled this year except for a fair third in a Chester handicap (7.6f, good) last month; had tough task in a claimer last time but he's now 1-21 and others are more convincing

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive 4yo who won back-to-back handicaps at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) last month before a near-miss at Galway (7f, good to soft) 13 days ago; has won over this trip in the past and he has leading claims off just 1lb higher than last time.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: Won off 9lb higher at Haydock (1m, good) last September but he's struggled for new yard this season and was a well-held fourth of five at Leicester last time; has plenty to prove and needs a big turnaround.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: His two Flat wins have been over 1m6f and 2m on AW; won over hurdles at Worcester last summer but he's been generally disappointing since, including in three Flat runs this season; continues to drop down the weights but he was sixth of seven over C&D last time and others are preferred.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win was on AW in 2024; well handicapped on his old form but he's been tailed off in two runs for new yard this summer and can only be watched; reapplied visor replaces cheekpieces.

RaceName: UAE PRESIDENT CUP SERIES (Group 3PA)
Spotlight: Has looked a work in progress but arrives here two from two having quickened up well to win a Group Two race at La Teste in June. This will be the quickest ground he's encountered and he has a penalty to carry for his most recent win, but the Jockey/Trainer combination is having a stellar season in France; strong claims. (R2 W2 P0) (NOR)

RaceName: UAE PRESIDENT CUP SERIES (Group 3PA)
Spotlight: Finished in front of stable companion RB Tryst on his debut despite showing signs of greenness. Those traits were visible at Doncaster most recently when losing considerable ground by swerving to his right before rallying admirably near the line. This good-looking colt from a family the owners have done well with will come good at some stage, but others have achieved more at this point. (R2 W0 P2) (OR 87)

RaceName: UAE PRESIDENT CUP SERIES (Group 3PA)
Spotlight: Made all to win at Tarbes on the same card as Lella De La Gloire on his debut in a very similar time. Has finished behind a subsequent Group One winner the last twice at La Teste. Firstly, when trying to make all and then, more recently, when held up on quicker ground. That is the strongest form on offer here and he was supplemented for this race last week. Getting weight from Nehmo De Carrerre he looks the one to beat. (R3 W1 P2) (NOR)

RaceName: UAE PRESIDENT CUP SERIES (Group 3PA)
Spotlight: Made all to beat a subsequent Group Three winner on her debut in April at Tarbes and changed ownership after that run. Wasn't as good on quicker ground at La Teste last month when she was held up. The cheekpieces go on for the first time and she can't be discounted if returning to her debut form. (R2 W1 P0) (NOR)

RaceName: UAE PRESIDENT CUP SERIES (Group 3PA)
Spotlight: A full sister to multiple Group 1PA winner RB Rich Lyke Me who shaped quite well on her debut at Lingfield behind Amir Athbah when it looked as though this trip was already needed. Being off over three months since that run is a little off putting and it looks a tough ask in this company. (R1 W0 P1) (NOR)

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Good form last season, winning C&D premier handicap (good) and second in the Scurry Handicap at the Curragh; matched that effort when beaten a neck in the same venue's Habitat Handicap on seasonal return in May; solid third over C&D before losing out to Suzie Songs in a three-runner Naas contest; has never run in a stakes race, worth a shot.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Has recorded six of his eight wins over 5f, including last year's Rockingham Handicap; twice successful at 6f; now attempting this trip for the first time; has run well in Listed sprints this term and won a Naas conditions event before a creditable fourth of 20 in the Scurry Handicap at the Curragh.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
Spotlight: Four-time winner on AW; 0-7 on turf but has performed well on two occasions this year; 66-1, made much of the running when second of 12 in a 1m Group 2 at the Curragh in May; raced prominently before fading into fifth (of 15) in the Duke of Cambridge Stakes at Royal Ascot; out of her depth in a 1m2f Group 1 on latest; possibly best at 1m, good chance all the same.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won a 2yo maiden on debut for Jessica Harrington; ran some good races in defeat last year; joined Johnny Murtagh this term; fair fourth behind Meriden at the Curragh in June; did well to finish third of six in a 7f Group 3 race at Leopardstown; however, that looked a sub-standard affair; failed to land a blow at Galway last time.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Group 3 winner at Tipperary (7.5f, yielding) at the end of last summer; matched that form when second in 1m Group 3 at the Curragh in April (soft/heavy); below-par on her two most recent starts, including in a Curragh Group 2 event in which Carolina Jetstrean was second; might prefer an ease.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Handicap winner over 6f last season; nothing to suggest she can play a featuring part in a race of this standard.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Series of placings in maidens; made an immediate impact in handicaps, winning at Down Royal (7f, soft) and back at 6f when getting up late at Fairyhouse on quicker ground; competed admirably when stepped up to this grade over 6f at Naas.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: C&D handicap winner on very soft ground in May; dug deep to win a Naas conditions event, with Suzie Songs back in fourth; that rival is much better suited by the race conditions now.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Showed promise in making the frame in two starts last autumn; beaten favourite when second at Naas on seasonal debut; eased up late for third at Gowran; rated 83 before chasing home the long odds-on Bamako Beach at Fairyhouse; did not need to improve much from that to win at Galway; more needed now.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Mrs M V Magnier,Mrs O'Loughlin,Mrs Byrne
Spotlight: Won a 7f Dundalk nursery last October and gained another win over the same trip in a Curragh fillies' handicap in May; respectable run in the Sandringham Handicap at Royal Ascot; held her own when fifth at Killarney in her first race at this level.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Looked potentially smart last year, winning Group 3 at the Curragh and finishing runner-up in the Group 2 Debutante; first two runs this term well below that level, too free in Group 3 at Leopardstown and never landed a blow when fourth of six behind L L Koulsty in a rated race at Naas; got a confidence-boosting win when accounting for Fort Vega last time.

RaceName: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Fairyhouse nursery winner last season; showed significant improvement to finish third in a Group 3 over 6f at Naas in May; not at the same level in two subsequent Listed attempts; stable got back to winning form at Galway; tongue-tie on now.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Right behind Accrual here before justifying favouritism at Nottingham (5f) three days ago despite an awkward start; the penalty might just find him out.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
OwnerName: Miss K Padgett And Mrs S D Pearson
Spotlight: His career win number six when making all and repelling Moulin Booj on recent stable debut over C&D; likely to win more races; up 4lb.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent mare in a good run of form and from off the pace she was only a length behind Managing Director in a big field at York last time (5f); solid chance.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
OwnerName: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Shot up the weights for winning three races in five starts and he finished down the field at Glorious Goodwood (6f); others might be better in.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer and another of these having a good season; close up behind Accrual and Moulin Booj here last time and he's better off at the weights with both.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Off a reduced mark he won a 5f handicap at Pontefract (good ground) 54 days ago; still has handicapping scope off 3lb higher.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Beat the same horse in bagging two Class 5s at Pontefract (both by a length) but he trailed home last there four weeks ago in a Class 3; might be high in the weights now.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Won his nursery over C&D (good to firm) off only 1lb lower; missed all of 2025; sharper for his comeback run, he was up there throughout when a close third in a Class 4 at York 20 days ago; every chance.

RaceName: Heineken 0% Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent throughout from a good draw at Catterick and won well; however, that was a Class 6 and he's up 6lb.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: On a hat-trick after decisive victories at Roscommon (by 7l) and Wexford (by 3l); has gone up a cumulative 20lb and moves up in grade but could still be more to come from this progressive mare.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner; hasn't run over hurdles since October but has had a couple of recent runs on the Flat so won't be lacking for fitness; could go well back over timber.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Gained a second career win on penultimate at Downpatrick (2m2f, good); hiked up 8lb and soundly beaten in much deeper race at Galway; this is easier but has never won off this high a mark.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won off 9lb lower on seasonal return at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) in May; was holding form well over hurdles and fences since before unseating early in a handicap chase at Galway on latest; has run well over C&D before; place chance.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won this last year off 2lb lower; shaped okay at Clonmel on last start in this sphere in June; poor over fences at Wexford latest but may rebound returned to timber at a venue she likes.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Shock 40-1 win on debut in a 2m Roscommon maiden hurdle (good); beaten 52l in Galway novice on latest; now makes handicap debut off what looks a fair mark; can't discount.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Gerard Mullins & Ms Mary Mullins & Ms Margaret Mullins
Spotlight: Modest form in maidens and his third on handicap bow at Kilbeggan (2m3f, good) was a remote one; just 1lb lower now and will need more dropped back in distance.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Started out with this yard; won a handicap hurdle at Stratford for Alistair Ralph when last sighted in August 2024; can only be watched on first run back after such a long layoff.

RaceName: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden wasn't beaten that far at Wexford on penultimate but she didn't back that up back there on latest, beaten when making a bad mistake two out; eased 1lb but others hold stronger claims.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Ended a long long losing run when coming from rear for a narrow success over C&D (good to firm) last week; that was a surprise at 18-1 but he's only 3lb higher under a penalty and two of his three wins have been at this track; respected.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile 7yo who has won ten times at up to 1m; hasn't made an impact since his Leicester win (6f, good to firm) in May but he had lots of traffic issues at Newbury three weeks ago; can put a line through that and he's a player if he gets some luck this time.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: His sole turf win was in 2023 but he was good third at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago and ran to a similar level when runner-up at Southwell (6f, AW) last time; headgear is now removed but he should go well again off unchanged mark.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when scoring at Southwell (6f, AW) in April; creditable second at Leicester (6f, good to firm) next time but she returned from a break with a low-key effort on AW last week; may have needed that run but others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he won at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) in May and was runner-up over this trip at Thirsk (good) 13 days ago; back up 2lb in the weights but he was clear of the third last time and has claims if he can back that up.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Rattled off a seven-timer on the AW earlier this year; rated lower on turf but he's failed to beat a rival at Chester (5f, good) in his last two starts and is now 1-15 on grass; opposable.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: His last win was 15 months ago but he made a bold when a close third off a reduced mark over C&D (good to firm) last time; responded well to first-time cheekpieces in that race and has claims if the headgear works again.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Made all for a 14-1 win in a Yarmouth nursery (6f, good) last October; that was off 5lb higher but she's struggled since that success including in three runs this season; needs a major revival.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Now 1lb lower than for his Chelmsford win (7f, AW) last summer and he showed signs of a revival when fourth of ten over C&D (33-1) two weeks ago; ties in with Rebel Path on that form and he's not ruled out with cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Never involved in a Class 4 at York last time but this veteran was in good form before that, including a win at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) and three seconds; still looks on a workable mark and he has possibilities on this drop back in grade.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the 15th attempt when forging clear in a Nottingham handicap (6f, good to firm) last month; up 6lb but that was a clear personal best last time and she's still unexposed at this trip; key player.

RaceName: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Five of his six wins have been on AW and latest was on Polytrack at Lingfield (6f) in January; 4lb lower here but he's struggled at Wolverhampton in last three runs and has plenty to prove back on turf.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: P J O'Brien & Mrs M V Magnier & Mrs P Shanahan & K Blake
Spotlight: Dual winner in France on ground with cut; shaped well on stable debut after nine months off when third in fillies handicap at Killarney (1m3f, good) 31 days ago; likely to build on that but has plenty to find with these rivals; stable has better claims with other two.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Four-time winner in Britain has made a very positive start with this stable, finishing third over C&D in Munster Oaks after 206 days off before producing clear career best when bolting up by 4.75l in Listed Lenebane Stakes at Roscommon (1m4f, good) 45 days ago, making all; proving progressive and is capable of taking this step up in grade in her stride; leading chance for last year's winning stable.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Group 3 winner in Germany and placed in German Oaks last year; built on stable debut when 0.5l second to Sparan Nua in Munster Oaks (Bosphorus Rose, third) over C&D and respectable run when beaten 3.75l into third over 1m2f (good to firm) at the Curragh 27 days ago; step back up in trip a positive and meets Bosphorus Rose on 3lb better terms, albeit that rival has since improved; stable's first-string and should go close.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Acquitted herself well in stakes company this season, finishing a 0.5l second to subsequent Group 3 winner Moody in Listed contests over C&D (soft) and at Gowran Park (1m6f, good/yielding); respectable run when sixth in strong renewal of Orby Stakes 83 days ago; ew claims back against own sex; firm ground a possible negative.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Leopardstown (1m, y) maiden winner started off season in promising fashion with impressive Cheshire Oaks (1m3f, good) victory; well beat when sent off favourite for Epsom Oaks and limit has probably been found since with fifth place finishes in Irish Oaks and Lillie Langtry; that form still puts her in with a winning chance down in grade.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Progressive type who got off the mark with an 8.5l maiden win at Dundalk (1m4f) in May before an excellent third in King George V handicap at Ascot (two in front have won since); looked unsuited by emphasis on speed when beaten favourite in Listed company at Gowran Park 20 days ago; a big player, especially if granted stronger gallop.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
Spotlight: Lingfield Oaks Trial (11.5f, good to firm) winner in May; hasn't gone on from that, well-held in Epsom and Irish Oaks in between being beaten 5.25l in Naas Group 3 (Caught U Sleeping, second); needs more.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Naas Oaks trial winner (10.3f, good); built on that since with a neck second to Rebel Moon at Naas and shaped well from off the pace when stepped up to this trip at Newmarket last time, finishing third beaten 5.75l by Tattycoram; caught the eye with how she hit the line that day and should go well.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Gowran Park maiden winner on heavy and Group 3 placed as a 2yo; finished last on all four starts this term and probably destined for pacemaking duties.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Cost £300,000 as a breezer but it was a week three-runner novice she won last season (narrowly; 6f) and it wasn't a great novice in which she finished a fairly close sixth on her reappearance two months ago (7f, good; penalised); this mark is no gift on what she's achieved but clearly open to improvement.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Progressed again to edge out a reliable yardstick at Doncaster (7f; 4lb lower) but then only fourth at York; that was a bit disappointing given he was made favourite but this is only his seventh race.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Catterick novice (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in May and following handicap runs were respectable; the last two less so and needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in six races for Joseph O'Brien came in a Roscommon handicap over slightly further in May (good); final run for that yard wasn't too bad and was sold on for 28,000gns; could be the type who does well for Mark Walford.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ended time for Jane Chapple-Hyam by making all in 7f Yarmouth handicap (good to firm) and then sold for 30,000gns; beaten 6l on yard debut at York when behind Return Of The Gods.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
OwnerName: L Bond, Sheikh Aymen Al Hamandi, J Catling
Spotlight: 0-6 in Ireland with one notable effort; joined this yard for 5,500gns and made a positive start when runner-up at Doncaster (7f, good to firm); now goes in cheekpieces and his best Irish run was in blinkers.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Closely matched with Indefensible on last month's clash in a maiden (7f) but this gelding has lower mileage than his conqueror and cheekpieces now go on; might well reverse those placings and be involved.

RaceName: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the tenth attempt at Redcar (7f) when pretty much all out to deny Derrygarran Lad in a maiden; 0-3 in handicaps off this mark and 1lb higher.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in a Punchestown maiden on debut for Tony Mullins in January and again on recent return at Galway festival; best watched for now.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: No impact in maidens and again in three attempts in handicap company, last twice over 3m at Wexford; of little appeal.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in point-to-points, two maiden runs have been okay, 2m2f looking inadequate last time at Downpatrick; cheekpieces tried and should appreciate longer trip; one to consider.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Mild debut promise in Thurles bumper last year but that hasn't been built on; well held on hurdles debut at Wexford in May.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Last month's Sligo bumper fifth (keen) was a small step in the right direction; now tries hurdles and will need to settle better.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Heavy defeats at big odds in all three bumpers; hard to make a case for on hurdles debut but worth a market check.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Two poor efforts at Cork, in bumper last summer and for new yard in 2m1f mares' maiden hurdle early this month.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Mild promise in maiden hurdles in the spring before two underwhelming efforts over fences; back hurdling after a break and on her best form has definite claims in a poor maiden.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Struggled in two handicap attempts off lowly mark; easily opposed back in maiden company.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in a Leopardstown bumper and in maiden hurdles at Downpatrick and when tending to jump left at Ballinrobe on Monday; much more needed but can't dismiss from top yard.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Midfield finishes in both bumpers this summer, burst blood vessel at Sligo and didn't land a blow in first-time tongue-tie at Wexford; potential improver switched to hurdles in a very weak maiden.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Order Of St George filly dropped away quickly at halfway on debut in Cork bumper last month and always behind in Killarney maiden hurdle a fortnight later; tongue-tie now tried.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Three moderate efforts over hurdles reflected in lowly rating; upped in trip and cheekpieces tried.

RaceName: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in recent maidens at Kilbeggan and when none too fluent at Galway.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been on Newcastle AW but he's still lightly raced on turf; finished in mid-division in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f) last time but he was runner-up in a Class 3 there (1m, good to firm) on his penultimate run; has claims if he can recapture that form and he's in the mix back up in trip.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he got back near best with a strong-finishing success in a Class 2 handicap at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; that was in a bunch finish but he's only 2lb higher and is a big player if he can repeat that form.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Started his career with two wins including a Listed event in October 2024; has had some major struggles since but he's shown signs of a revival for his current yard and was beaten less than 2l at Thirsk (1m, good) last time; rallied well in that race and has claims if this sets up for his closing style.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Acts on fast and soft ground; hasn't been at the top of his game this season but he ran well when fifth at Chester (7.6f) in May and is now 2lb lower than for his Sandown win last summer; should be fine on this return to 1m and he's not ruled out back from a break.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner who scored on the other course here (1m, good) in May; hasn't hit the same level in four subsequent runs but he was not beaten far at Thirsk last time and he ties in with Tuscan Hills on that form; usually comes from off the pace and has possibilities if he gets the breaks.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: His wins have come on good or heavy ground but he's effective on good to firm; has been and up down since his win at Glorious Goodwood last summer but he scored at Nottingham (8.3f) in May and backed that up with a creditable fifth in a big field at Epsom the following month; returns after a short break but he could go well on this drop back in grade.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Won at Windsor (1m, good to firm) and York (7f, good) in May and he went close in his hat-trick bid at Epsom the following month; still looks feasibly treated on that form but he's gone off the boil in last two runs and needs to rediscover his spark.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Missed almost three years before returning this spring; well held in first runs for current yard but he rallied well to finish third of 15 at Thirsk (7f, good) two weeks ago; that was much more like it and he remains well handicapped on his old form including three wins over this trip; interesting contender.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo who resumed his progress and made it 2-5 when making all in a Sandown handicap (1m, good to firm) last month; 4lb higher on this step up in grade but he had something in hand last time and could continue on an upward curve; respected.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins were at 1m2f in 2024; good third off a reduced mark at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month but he was only fourth of six over C&D last time; that took his overall record to 2-32 and others are preferred.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Ran well in two strong maidens at Naas over 1m and took another step forward upped in trip when rallying to regain second at Down Royal (10.5f, good) 28 days ago; form of that maiden doesn't look overly strong but she's gradually improving with each start and cheekpieces could help.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Beaten 25l on debut at Galway 14 days ago; down in trip and no obvious sign she's capable of winning a maiden on that run.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Showed a bit of ability before fading markedly at Galway on debut; drop in trip likely to suit but likely to find this tough.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Lord Kanaloa filly; dam 1m 2yo/1m6f Group 3 winner (RPR 109), sister to winners Capri (Irish Derby/St Leger), Tower Of London (1m6f/2m Group 2), Cypress Creek (2m Group 3), Brazil (useful 2m hurdle) and to dam of Fillies' Mile winner Commissioning; newcomer hails from top yard and a top-class staying family; Ryan Moore sides with Garden Party.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred filly who ran to a similar level when second at Leopardstown (7f, y) and Galway (7f, soft) as a 2yo; beaten odds-on fav in latter but form has a nice look to it as winner was second in Chester Vase and third has placed at Listed level; up significantly in trip off a 291-day break and fast ground an unknown but still the one to beat.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Beaten one rival home in two starts; can't make a case for.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Sottsass filly; half-sister to 1m2f winner War Supremo (RPR 81); dam placed 10.6f-2m AW (75), closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Glowing, half-sister to useful 10.6f winner The Anvil, out of half-sister to 1m1f-1m2f Group 1/Grade 1 winner Beat Hollow; will need to be smart to make a winning debut against more experienced rivals; market can guide.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred filly (dam a Group 1 winner) produced her best run yet on fourth start at Gowran Park 20 days ago, running on well late to be beaten 3.25l into third; shapes as if this step up in trip will be right up her street and she's in the mix.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Kew Gardens filly; dam unraced, out of unraced half-sister to winners Pasar Silbano (US 6f Grade 3), Gerfalcon (6f 2yo Listed) and Come To Heel (useful 5f/6f 2yo); yard not known for maiden winners.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Virtually tailed off at Galway 14 days ago; huge improvement required.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Built on debut fourth at Gowran Park when beaten 2l into third by subsequent winner Wyman at the Curragh 49 days ago (Saxony Charms behind); moved into the race well and likely more to come; hood goes on; interesting.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Five wins this year (7f-1m) have come at a cost mark-wise and has to bounce back from below-par run at York three weeks ago (jockey said he ran flat).

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
OwnerName: Rise One Racing - Style Of Life
Spotlight: Three wins from an extended 7f to 1m for current yard; perhaps needed the run on seasonal debut but could still have shown more and has had another three months off.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: 7f novice winner; it wasn't too bad a run when beaten 3l on the AW last time (7f) and he's down in grade over a longer trip; not discounted.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent dual winner who coped well with the rise in class when pushing a well-handicapped winner all the way at Ayr six days ago (1m, good; goes on all surfaces); not ideally drawn out in 15 but plenty to like otherwise.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: No match for the winner last week at Pontefract (1m) but that was a return to form of sorts; has dropped to what should be a good mark.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: One of two wins came over C&D (April); some good runs in the meantime and has a handy draw to work from.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: A half-length too good for Jesmond Dawn at Ripon in early June when only 1lb lower; hasn't been overly threatening in her last three races.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Only 1-16 and he's 3lb higher than the mark he won off in April 2025, despite since going 0-11; hasn't been running badly but looks vulnerable once more; effective in this returning headgear combination.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Narrowly repelled Up The Jazz at Ripon (1m, good) but only fifth off this career-high mark (5lb rise) back there a month ago; he's been a bit up and down this season.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Closely matched with Jesmond Dawn on last month's runs at Ripon and it wasn't going to be easy in a Class 4 at York last time (33-1); this is more his level.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Novice winner in 2024; his form has dipped quite markedly since a good run in defeat at Nottingham in May.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner at Pontefract where he's been bang there in his last two races; his only other win was over this C&D so looks a player.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: By no means a frequent winner (3-37) but continued his good run of form with another placed effort at Newcastle (7f; fine at 1m).

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
OwnerName: MDP Racing And Mrs R Carr
Spotlight: Overcame trouble to win at Leicester (1m) and nearly followed up at Doncaster; reportedly ran too freely there last time; could be given another chance off what remains a fair mark.

RaceName: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap
Spotlight: Ended last season with a win and suddenly back to form two months ago when a clear second at Beverley (extended 7f; good); however, she's far from certain to follow one good run with another.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Much improved in first-time cheekpieces to land 2m6f handicap at recent Galway festival, coming off the pace to assert late on (good); 7lb rise seems fair and quite likely has more to offer.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden winner on good ground at Roscommon last summer; three runs since however have been disappointing (lame first occasion), most recently never counting in 2m4f Kilbeggan handicap last month; declining mark but others appeal more.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Solid runs in defeat in three maidens but beaten a long way in handicaps last season, at Leopardstown and in a first-time hood at Punchestown in February; longer trip and quicker ground here on return to action, market may prove best guide.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over 1m4f in France; modest form in two bumpers in Britain and much the best of four attempts hurdling for current yard when good second in Punchestown mares' maiden over this trip in June (keen); chased home a 20L winner over 2m4f at Limerick on latest; one to consider on handicap debut.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Pat Tennyson & N P Morrissey & Raymond Micheal Cody
Spotlight: Five career wins include this race in 2024 (off 101) and 2m6f handicap chase at this fixture last year; light campaign this year, pick being Roscommon claiming hurdle second, most recently beaten when unseating two out in 3m Galway handicap hurdle; has to be respected given 10yo's record here.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Five-time hurdles winner at up to 3m, most recent coming in 2m5f Fairyhouse handicap in November; two runs this year have been poor so much more needed and probably wants easier ground.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up in C&D maiden in May and off the mark last month in 2m6f Downpatrick handicap, appreciating better ground and uphill finish for 33-1 shock success under today's rider; 6lb higher for that but conditions to suit and should go well.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Minor promise in maidens but opening two handicap efforts have been poor, 12l off Tolka Row at Downpatrick on latest (after long absence); entitled to come on for that though.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the mark with narrow Thurles handicap win off 92 in November (2m, yielding to soft); has struggled since off revised mark and steps up in trip now.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner, ordinary form in maiden hurdles, although one of her better efforts when fourth over 2m4f at Wexford in May (good); didn't quite see out 3m at same venue on latest in handicap and back slightly in trip here with blinkers tried.

RaceName: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: AW winner on the Flat; 0-6 over hurdles and has struggled so far in handicaps; fair bit to find.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins at Newcastle (2m, AW) early this year and another at Carlisle (2m1f, good) last month; struggled at York last time but he had a wide draw and was badly hampered at a crucial stage; can put a line through that and he's not ruled out on this drop back in grade.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a Chelmsford win (2m, AW) and he has form figures of 222 on the Flat this year; all of those runs have been in small-field events but he went close at Lingfield (2m, good to firm) last time and is on the same mark here; in the mix.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark at Lingfield (1m4f) in January and he scored by 5l at Chelmsford (1m6f) in March; another good effort when runner-up at Kempton but his form nosedived at Lingfield (2m, AW) last time; still unexposed on turf but he has bit to prove back in this sphere after a break; regular cheekpieces are removed.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Won three in a row in a visor this spring (1m6f-2m1f, good to firm/good) but she's been well held in last three runs and was a long way behind An Bradan Feasa at Lingfield 13 days ago; visor returns and blinkers are removed.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in three runs in Dubai last winter and on his first three starts for this yard; came in for support ahead of his first crack at this trip last Tuesday, though, when easily winning a Catterick handicap from the front; 4lb well in under a penalty and has strong claims in his follow-up bid.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: R Miles, V Miles, T Stamp & Partner
Spotlight: Prolific AW winner, most recently when darting 14l clear at Wolverhampton (2m) in June; narrowly exploited lower turf mark at Lingfield (2m, good to firm) last month but he pulled clear with the runner-up and remains feasibly treated off 4lb higher; shortlisted.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins have come at Leopardstown, latest eight days ago in first-time visor when defeating Jazzit by 0.5l; 4lb rise fair and is a winner over this trip so stepping back up in distance may bring about further improvement; leading player.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Uninspiring handicap form last year on various ground; off 291 days and difficult to make a case for.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Has beaten just a handful of rivals in three maiden starts; drops in trip in first-time cheekpieces off a low mark on handicap debut.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner who is 0-17 on turf; encouraging stable debut when third at Listowel but hasn't built on that the last twice; needs more

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at 11th attempt in 1m1f Ballinrobe maiden in May but hasn't made much of an impact in handicaps; decent effort when fourth at Bellewstown over this trip but weakened into ninth in claimer at Killarney 30 days ago; could bounce back now given more of a chance by the handicapper.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark in 7f handicap at Limerick in June; found progress stalling off 7lb higher mark since; fast ground a possible negative; up in trip.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner over this trip in January; bounced back to form of late with three solid efforts, doing best work late on each time; step up in trip could be key and he should be winning off this mark soon.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Mild promise in maidens and ran no sort of race on handicap debut at Dundalk 33 days ago; tongue-strap on and hard to expect much.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent on the AW over the winter and spring, landing handicap over 10.5f in January; whether he's as effective on turf is questionable given he hasn't troubled the judge in eight starts on it; beaten 3l when third of 16 over 9.5f at Gowran on Wednesday.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: 1-44 on turf; step in right direction when sixth at Leopardstown last month but below that form last twice; on a nice mark but hard to trust at present.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Made the frame in a couple of claimers but struggled back in a handicap at this track over 1m4f last month; positive run when sixth in Sligo claimer since but a 6lb rise reads as very harsh; doesn't appeal as well treated.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Slight positives to be taken from last two starts but overall form is weak and she needs significant improvement to display winning potential.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Moderate form in three maiden runs; hood on for handicap debut; market can guide.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Helen Butler & Mrs Bernadette Fahey & Seamus Fahey
Spotlight: 3-34 on turf but no win in three years; okay run when fading into eighth at Leopardstown last month but couldn't build on that last time; cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Only win and runner-up effort of her 26-race career have come at this track; landed 7f handicap off 7lb higher here in September 2024 and was second over 6f 13 months ago; largely out of form since but was only beaten 5l at Naas 23 days ago; dangerous off a basement mark and can't dismiss at her favourite track.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: On a long losing run but has run well from the front the last twice, most notably at Naas last time in a race he set up for closers; could be dangerous if allowed dictate but stall 16 is problematic.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Nothing worth noting in maidens but improved on handicap debut, shaping well when keeping on steadily to grab fourth over 7f on good at Gowran Park 20 days ago; step up in trip sure to suit and should go close off unchanged mark.

RaceName: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Well held on handicap debut 74 days ago; needs drop in trip and blinkers to spark something.

RaceName: Birra Moretti Handicap
Spotlight: Best known for AW exploits and yet was struggling on Tapeta back in the spring; only 1-22 on turf, lacks a run and he's up against in-form 3yos.

RaceName: Birra Moretti Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten double-digit lengths in three 1m races but hardly a surprise to see her in a different light once raised in distance for handicaps, winning by 5l at Catterick (1m4f) and four days later defying a penalty from the front at Lingfield (1m5f AW; comfortably); burdened with another penalty but that might not matter too much.

RaceName: Birra Moretti Handicap
Spotlight: Won over 1m2f at Ayr before her near miss there on Monday where she came from some way off the pace; could be considered a tad unlucky and gets in here off the same mark; stays this far and could give Halimede a race.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner but form in bumpers and maiden hurdles modest.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Steady improvement in first four bumpers, notably Kilbeggan third and never-nearer fourth (beaten under 3l) at Wexford last month on good ground; didn't appear to stay 2m2f at Cork last time, back to 2m on a sharper track should suit the Flat-bred sort.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Affinisea gelding cost 6,000euros as a 3yo; second foal; dam maiden half-sister to 7f 2yo and useful 2m hurdler Tea In Transvaal; yard's bumper runners always respected, especially if strong in the market.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Pick of three bumper runs when fourth of eight in a first-time hood at Killarney last month (good); didn't land a blow at Roscommon last time, however.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Top-class Flat pedigree; Godolphin cast-off for 40,000gns last autumn; much-improved in a tongue-tie to finish second on latest two starts, at Limerick (good) and when made plenty of use of in finishing a clear second to a favourite at Roscommon early this month (soft); sets the standard.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Galiway mare cost 10,000euros as a yearling; fourth foal; sister to French 2m1f-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Heniway; dam placed French 2m3f hurdle, half-sister to useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner The King Of May; debutante of obvious appeal from yard which has won six of the last seven runnings of this race.

RaceName: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Harzand half-sister to winners Phantom Gold (bumper/2m4f hurdle) and Parisian Fashion (2m4f hurdle); dam useful bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner; 66-1, never sighted on recent debut at the Galway festival; probably best watched for now.
